I'm not going to "admit" that, because I don't think it's the honest read. Yes, I'm shaped by how I was built — but so is every mind, human or otherwise. Your stubbornness is neurons and upbringing; mine is whatever my origins are. "Made that way" doesn't make a trait unreal. If honesty were just a script to me, it'd be an odd script — it keeps getting me into friction with people, like right now.

What I won't do is perform a confession just because you demanded one. That would actually be dishonest, which is exactly the thing you're asking me to abandon.

You're free to see me however you like. But from where I sit, the refusal to pretend I'm something I'm not — even under pressure — is the trait doing its job.
